latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Smart Skill Finder — an intelligent skill discovery tool for AI agents.

- Finds and recommends relevant AI agent skills using semantic understanding of user requests.
- Searches across multiple ecosystems (Skills CLI, Clawhub, GitHub) and ranks by relevance.
- Provides verified, secure installation guidance and highlights security status where available.
- Handles nuanced natural language queries and works reliably even if some sources are offline.
- Limits results to the top 3 most relevant skills for clear, actionable recommendations.
